about: The cast: each look is a stage.py spec (skin colour and free Roblox catalog items that fit R6), named by the part it plays. Our own designs: never the references' narrator (brown swept hair, purple round sunglasses) or their beanie kid. Checked on R6 in Studio; items logged in ATTRIBUTION.md.
